# Sun America Realty

> Commercial real estate brokerage and investment serving Greater Tampa Bay — Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Hernando, and Polk counties, Florida. Land brokerage, entitlements, deal structuring, and direct investment. In the market since 1980.

Sun America Realty, LLC is a Florida commercial real estate brokerage led by Larry Guilford (Broker of Record, in the market since 1980) and Brian Orr (Sales Associate). The firm covers Greater Tampa Bay — the I-275, I-75, and I-4 corridors, the Veterans/Suncoast Parkway, plus SR-54, SR-52, SR-50, and SR-60 — with focus on commercial land, development sites, repositioning, and income-producing properties across all five counties.
